questions.q: For a steady-state process with no reaction, the overall mass balance is:
questions.e: Mass is conserved; moles are not unless no reaction/mole change.

questions.q: A purge stream in a recycle loop is used to:
c: Prevent accumulation of inerts or by-products
questions.e: Without a purge, inert components build up in the loop.

questions.q: Selectivity differs from yield in that selectivity is:
c: Moles of desired product per mole of reactant converted to all products
Moles of product per mole fed regardless of conversion
The ratio of recycle to feed
questions.e: Overall yield also accounts for conversion; selectivity compares desired to total products.

questions.q: The Reynolds number for pipe flow is:
questions.e: Flow is generally turbulent when Re exceeds about 4000.

questions.q: The heat transferred in an exchanger is:
questions.e: U overall coefficient, A area, ΔT_lm log-mean temperature difference.

questions.q: For the same terminal temperatures, which arrangement gives the larger log-mean temperature difference?
questions.e: Counter-current provides larger average driving force and permits temperature cross.

c: Distillation cannot separate A and B
questions.e: Vapor and liquid compositions are identical.

questions.q: The minimum reflux ratio in a distillation column corresponds to:
questions.e: At minimum reflux the operating line touches the equilibrium curve (pinch).

questions.q: Using the Fenske equation with α = 2, x_D = 0.99 and x_B = 0.01 (relative to the light key), the minimum number of equilibrium stages (total reflux) is about:

questions.e: Equal molar latent heats make vapor and liquid molar flows constant in each section.

questions.q: By the six-tenths rule, doubling equipment capacity increases the cost by a factor of about:
A Lang-type factor is used to:
c: Estimate total fixed capital cost from the purchased equipment cost
questions.e: Installation, piping, instrumentation, etc. are included via multiplicative factors.

questions.q: A project with a positive net present value at the required discount rate is:
questions.e: Discounted cash flows exceed the investment.

questions.q: Guide words used in a HAZOP study include:
questions.e: They are applied to process parameters to identify deviations.

questions.q: List the four principles of inherently safer design.
questions.m: Minimize (use smaller inventories), Substitute (replace hazardous materials/processes with less hazardous ones), Moderate (use milder conditions or forms), and Simplify (design to eliminate complexity and error opportunities).
